notes.content:
[h1]Patchnotes[/h1]

[h2]Items[/h2]

Add [b]Health Switch[/b] (variant of Medical Switch that works for the doll's total health instead of a single bodypart)
Add [b]Velocity Switch[/b] (triggers linked items when reaching high enough velocity, customizable via Trigger Force)
Add [b]Pointer Random[/b] (variant of Pointer that points in a random direction whenever triggered)
Rename Stasis Field as [b]Stasis Beam[/b]
Add [b]Stasis Field[/b] (stasis in AoE)
Add [b]Stasis Caster[/b] (stasis linked)

Modify [b]Arcanity[/b] to not cut linked items with its effect

Fix [b]Eden[/b] and [b]Ghost Shotgun[/b] pellets colliding with static ghosts
Fix [b]Soulstorm[/b] projectiles not being ghosted by default
Fix [b]Camo Mine[/b] not copying colours
Fix [b]Dark Gnome Mask[/b] and [b]Drone Mask[/b] not ending their effects when destroyed

[h2]Features[/h2]

Add [b][Fleshcrafting > % Regeneration][/b] that modifies Regeneration property speed.

Add negative values support to various Fleshcrafting settings:
  - [b]Bullet Damage, Blunt Damage, Bleed Damage, Sharp Damage, and Regeneration[/b]
  - Reversing the multipliers will cause healing when normally damaged, to allow things like bullet absorbing.
  - Negative values may cause wildly unexpected things to happen, are entirely unbalanced, and largely untested. Enjoy.

Add [b][Properties > Physics > Resist Joints][/b] (Joints will not attach to the item. Existing joints will remain, even after saving and loading)
Add [b][Properties > Alive   > Resist Armour][/b] (Armour pieces will not automatically equip on the doll. Armours equipped before adding the property will remain equipped, even after saving and loading.)

Add [b][Alt+Click][/b] to pick a colour with the cursor when the colour menu is open

Add visualization to [b][Detail > Joints][/b] displaying which joint will be removed

Add console command menualpha=[0-1] that changes the opacity (1 = default, 0 = invisible) of currently open menus for the current session.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

Modify [b]Resist Freezing[/b]:
  - Now caps temperature at 1C instead of blocking changes entirely (aka allows extinguishing fires by freezing)
  - Sub-zero dolls with the property are able to stand and receive visible wounds

Modify [b]Concussing[/b] property to concuss for longer to make it useful for bullet jackets
Modify [b]Hyped[/b] property force to be less immediately deadly

Fix Flip hotkey not being mappable (default: Tab+mouseover)

[h2]Steam[/h2]

Hopefully finally fix Steam workshop sometimes not loading all subscribed content

[h2]MaD Lab[/h2]

Fix MaD Lab models embedded in saves not updating the Library on load (making them lose functionality)
Add triggers::ApplyEffectToLinked (see xml Stasis Caster)
Modify triggers::ApplyEffectInRadius triggerCustom to support particles (see xml Stasis Field)

[b][Detail Tool > Gunsmith][/b] adds various settings for modifying guns and bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/569b99c7e63c482f242e01309e0be36daab84abb.png[/img]

Like that sniper that shoots 50 bullets.

[b][Detail Tool > Bullet Jacket][/b] allows modifying the properties applied to bullets**.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/e349b61814dfa22f0273e69f4491d87982c77655.png[/img]

Like a sneaky cornershotgun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/6b6dae9a0922bacc204524933b161595376ca30f.gif[/img]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/c49c65951a8b75e006e4c7e6c3fbec35bdceac81.png[/img]

[b][Detail Tool > Muzzle Sound][/b] allows overriding the gunshot sound and volume of the gun.

- 13 new sound effects have been added in the Firearms category.

- Some old sound effects have been modified and renamed to be more descriptive.

- Old gun volumes have been normalized to be more in line with each other (instead of shotgun shooting your ears off.)

May be expanded to also include other muzzle things, in some form, at a later time.




[h3]* Gunsmithing Details[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/e32fe75a0b2ac4ed603042e72812f402f317cdbe.png[/img]

- [b]Velocity[/b] and [b]Scatter[/b] affect the velocity that bullets shoot at, which is [i]not[/i] affected by the bullet's weight. A baseline forward Velocity is applied first away from the barrel position, which is then modified by a random Scatter. For example a Velocity 100 / Scatter 100 bullet can vary between 50 and 150 final velocity. Meaning that Scatter can make bullets shoot backwards if it's too high.

- [b]Recoil[/b] affects the force applied to the gun, which [i]is[/i] affected by the gun's weight. There is no upwards recoil.

- [b]Bullet Size %[/b] may be wildly different between different types of bullets, because it's a multiplier of the size of the bullet (whose models may be of various sizes -- e.g. the model used for shotgun pellets at 100% are huge.)

- Most old guns don't have reloading, as it was added later on. For example the Assault Rifle shoots infinitely as it has a [b]Magazine Size[/b] of 1 bullet and [b]Reload Time[/b] of 6 frames, as opposed to modern guns using [b]Bullet Delay[/b] for the time between each bullet, and [b]Reload Time[/b] only after the magazine is empty.

- [b]Bullet Delay[/b], [b]Reload Time[/b], and [b]Burst Delay[/b] are measured in frames (aka ticks/updates.) The game tries its best to run at 60 frames per second. For example most assault rifles use 3-6 frames delays between bullets (aka 10-20 bullets per second fire rate.)

- [b]Burst Amount[/b] enables burst shooting when above 1, which makes the gun automatically shoot multiple bullets in a row when triggered. Bursting uses [b]Bullet Delay[/b] between each bullet, [b]Burst Delay[/b] between each burst, and [b]Reload Time[/b] once the magazine is emptied.

For example Battle Rifle shoots as follows:
  [b]Bullet[/b]
  (Bullet Delay)
  [b]Bullet[/b]
  (Bullet Delay)
  [b]Bullet[/b]
  (Burst Delay)
   ...
  (Reload Time)
  
  
  
[h3]** Bullet Jacket Details[/h3]

The name "Bullet Jacket" was picked to describe the fact that the [b]properties only apply to generic physical bullets[/b]. 

Meaning that a good chunk of weirder projectiles won't use the properties [i]at all[/i], because most properties require a collision to apply them.

  E.g. A lot of weapons use raycasts instead of physical projectiles (Blasters, Lasers, Rays, etc.)
  E.g. Various weapons shoot ghosted AoE projectiles (Microwave Gun, Shockwave Gun, etc.)
  E.g. Some weapons don't spawn any projectiles (Boomstick, Frost Cannon, etc.)

Some properties also aren't available for bullets, e.g. most Alive and Physics properties, because they would break things or not work at all.

----





[h1]Patchnotes[/h1]

(See also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/665370/view/3336619489918963247]Guns Guns Guns patchnotes[/url].)

[h3]Guns[/h3]
[b]Added Gunsmith, Bullet Jacket, and Muzzle Sound to Detail tool when modifying a gun[/b]
[b]Added 34 new guns[/b], and some projectiles
Modified guns to increase magazine size if burst size would exceed it
Modified bursting guns to behave better with Trigger tool
Fix some bullets being erroneously ghosted
Fix some bullets needlessly overriding default shooting behaviour
Fix various bullets being rotated wrong

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
Modified [b]burning to deal more devastating damage[/b]
Modified Flaming property to heat up items faster, and have fancier particles
Modified Lava to increase initial temperature when applied
Fix deepfrying capping temperature at 80
Fix item triggers not reseting after being crabbed
Fix Crash minigame not starting
Rename Flame Thrower as Fire Thrower to distinguish it from Flamethrower
Rename Tazer as Shocker because that's what it does
Rename Alive settings tooltip as Fleshcrafting so it's more memorable

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
Added muzzle flash to shotguns
Modified all flame bullets to use new flame graphics to distinguish them from particles better

[h3]Sounds[/h3]
[b]Added 13 new sound effects in [Sounds > Firearms][/b] and renamed various old ones
Modified various sound effects and volumes
Randomized bullet-alive and bullet-wall sound volumes, and made it so they can't stack
Randomized ricochet volumes

[h3]Misc[/h3]
Modified save history to contain up to 20 saves
Modified Drag Tool to have a minimum force (to make dragging low weight items feel better)
Modified various tool tooltips to include quick use information (e.g. Rotating with left/right arrow keys)
Modified Dark Sprite bites to deal more damage, and it not to destroy itself while feasting, and only after Duration otherwise (instead of randomly)
Fix hyping and transmuting kind of affecting walls
Fix doll joint Break Force always showing 20000 after saveload

[h3]MaD Lab[/h3]

Added inheritSettings for bullets to use the firearms' force/radius/duration

[h3]Damage Tweaks[/h3]

- [b]Generic blunt damage is higher[/b] by default

- [b]Giblets have been tweaked[/b] to have more varied sizes and models, to inherit more velocity, burst into blood better, and disintegrate more randomly

- Slightly larger chunks are allowed to turn into giblets, but on average fewer giblets will spawn compared to before

- Low-mass alive items will produce fewer giblets, to avoid gibsplosions when rapidly cutting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/8f1e3b650c496684861b2092b8bfd0c62eae326e.png[/img]

[h3]Misc Tweaks[/h3]

- Main menu does things now

- Add console command "detaillocked [0/1]" (temporarily toggles whether or not detail tool can area select locked items)

- [b]Launch tool has been improved[/b] to use wheel rotation and mass rotation

- [b]Wheel rotation has been modified[/b] so selected item only rotates while dragging/moving

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/c283f542eece601ecff5b4d8943260fe535d35b6.png[/img]

[h3]Item Fixes[/h3]

- [b]Bleach+Ammonia collision[/b] works properly again

- [b]Electricity and Neuro gas won't cause bleeding[/b] any more

- [b]Explosions are more explody[/b] aka previously-intended more cuts per explosion were not working properly

- Items with Resist Shock are no longer triggered by Shock power


[h3]Misc Fixes[/h3]

- Cloning no longer disables Vanilla spawn property

- Compressed triggerCustom won't fail to load sometimes

- Wheel speed setting loads at correct values now


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/8f1e3b650c496684861b2092b8bfd0c62eae326e.png[/img]


[h2]MaD Lab[/h2]
MaD Lab is the item editor made from scratch specifically for MaD2 content creation.

The Cryolab update added an XML-based model functionality support to MaD Lab and MaD2, which has since been expanded to be the main content creation workflow for the game.

See the documentation for more info: https://gitlab.com/RavaGames/madlab/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/8ce81440db6db3a4430eea0830af7e89eb41e300.png[/img]

While the system was originally made to make item creation easier for myself, all of the new functionalities in this update were also made to be as generic as possible so they can be applied to other models as well and tweaked. (At least, where feasible, e.g. there's kind of no way to generalize an item that spawns spaghetti.)

From my point of view the system works brilliantly for content creation -- tweaking item model values in Lab while the game is running and then refreshing to see the changes in-game is just great.

More items and more functionalities will follow.

[h3]Misc[/h3]

- Add temperature and temperatureMelt attribute support into functionality

- Add "stormcloud" projectile

[h3]Triggers[/h3]
Use via [i]trigger="triggers::TriggerNameCaseSpecific"[/i] in functionality XML.

- [b]AimAtLinkedAttachment[/b] (makes gun aim at linked item while attached, e.g.  triggerPos="0,-20" triggerForce="100" triggerColour="e92d15")

- [b]Airstrike[/b] (Spawns Force amount of linked items every Duration after triggered, items ignore walls and trigger on collision)

- [b]AnnoyingAlarmClock[/b] (Bounces around.)

- [b]ApplyEffectInRadius[/b] (applies body effect in radius, e.g. triggerCustom="gib")

- [b]ApplyEffectOnSharp[/b] (applies body effect on sharp hit, e.g. triggerCustom="gib")

- [b]ApplyForceSpecific[/b] (e.g. Slipping Sign: triggerForce="100" triggerRadius="200" triggerPos="150,0" triggerCustom="items=doll_foot,doll_leg;force=1,0;pos=0,100;randomForce=true")

- [b]AutoJoint[/b] (welds items to itself when something hits the joint line, similar to firearm attachments. E.g. triggerPos="0,-20" triggerColour="e92d15")

- [b]CameraFollowLinked[/b] (makes camera follow the first linked item)

- [b]D20[/b] (Rolls a number between 1 and Force. Triggers items when the highest value is rolled.)

- [b]DestroyOnColour[/b] (Destroys other item when hit by layer with Colour. e.g. triggerColour="FF00FF")

- [b]DisintegrateIntoItems[/b] (same as SpawnItem except spawns multiple items by adding amount=n in triggerCustom)

- [b]DisintegrateIntoParticles[/b] (e.g. triggerCustom="particle=tinysprinkle;amount=20" triggerColour="FF00FF" triggerContact="10")

- [b]DisintegrateOnHit[/b] (applies DisintegrateIntoItems to items it hits, with same triggerCustom parameters, e.g. triggerCustom="items=chilipepper;posX=0;posY=0;scale=0.5;destroy=false;amount=10;randomScale=1;randomPos=1;particle=fire3" triggerColour="FF0000" triggerCollide="50")

- [b]DoorSwitch[/b] (toggles ghost and sets alpha to Force% on trigger, and resets on untrigger. Only toggles alpha when triggerState="1")

- [b]DrainHeal[/b] (drains Force health from items in Radius, and sends it to linked items.)

- [b]DrawStage[/b] (draws the stage on the item, e.g. triggerCustom="posX=0,posY=-60,scale=0.075")

- [b]EmitProjectile[/b] (triggerForce="Forward Emit Force", triggerDuration="Frames To Emit", triggerPos="X,Y", triggerCustom="Projectile Name")

- [b]ExplodeInRadius[/b] (makes all items in radius explode every duration frames)

- [b]FireworkGrenade[/b] (same as firework except explodes more and doesn't fly, e.g. triggerForce="1000" triggerRadius="200" triggerPos="0,-15" triggerDuration="30")

- [b]JointSlinger[/b] (1. Creates a joint from Pos forwards, up to Radius away. 2. Pulls towards it at Force for Duration. 3. Destroys the joint and starts all over again. E.g. triggerForce="100" triggerDuration="30" triggerColour="94deef" triggerPos="36,0" triggerRadius="1962")

- [b]LinkLinkedToRay[/b] (links from linked items to items that touch the ray. E.g. triggerForce="100" triggerColour="259e25" triggerPos="20,0")

- [b]LinkToJointed[/b] (Links linked items to jointed items when triggered.)

- [b]MagnetWhenSwung[/b] (attracts items in triggerRadius by triggerForce when spinning or moving fast enough, e.g. triggerRadius="200" triggerForce="500")

- [b]MeltAndPour[/b] (Temperature in radius, destroy on colour, and pour projectiles combined. E.g. triggerForce="100" triggerRadius="50" triggerCustom="items=magma,lava;start=-10,-25;end=10,-25;angle=75;chance=0.05" ignore="magma" triggerColour="FF00FF")

- [b]PourSpawnProjectile[/b] (e.g. triggerCustom="items=worm;start=-10,-20;end=10,-20;angle=75;chance=0.05")

- [b]ProjectilesOnEverything[/b] (Spawns custom projectiles when moving too fast, or hitting with sharp)

- [b]ProjectilesOnSharp[/b] (Spawns custom projectiles the next frame after hitting with sharp)

- [b]ProjectilesWhenSpun[/b] (spawns custom projectile every duration frames, when spinning faster than force e.g. triggerCustom="magma" triggerDuration="8" triggerForce="50")

- [b]ProjectilesWhenSpunOrSwung[/b] (Spawns custom projectiles when speed exceeds force)

- [b]RandomEffectInRadius and RandomEffectOnHit

- [b]RandomPropertiesOnHit[/b] (Adds force amount of random properties to the item[/b] (not its victims) on hit and while triggered, capping at 50)

- [b]Refactor generic visual effects[/b] (e.g. burn/freeze/radiation/etc visuals on alive items. This should change nothing, but is mentioned for bug reporting purposes in case any issues are found.)

- [b]RotAndWorms[/b] (e.g. triggerColour="6a6533" triggerDuration="30")

- [b]SayRandomLine[/b] (says a random line of text when shaken or thrown e.g. triggerCustom="Yes.;No.")

- [b]SetTemperatureInRadius[/b] (Heats or cools temperature of items in Radius towards Force over Duration)

- [b]SpaghettiInRadius[/b] (Summons spaghetti in Radius that slaps items away with Force. E.g. triggerRadius="200" triggerForce="100" triggerPos="0,-30")

- [b]SpawnItems[/b] (triggerCustom="items=id,id,...;posX=number,number,...;posY=number,number,...;rot=number,number,...")

- [b]SpawnItemsCraft[/b] (same as SpawnItems, except has "targets=a,b,c" in triggerCustom, only triggering when hitting any of those items, e.g. triggerCustom="items=glasssword;targets=glassswordblade;posX=0;posY=-38;rot=0")

- [b]SpawnItemsSlowly[/b] (spawns linked items slowly, e.g. triggerCustom="posX=0,posY=0,forceX=0,forceY=0" triggerDuration="120")

- [b]SpawnItemsWhenSwung[/b] (spawns items every triggerDuration frames when spinning or moving fast enough, inheriting base item's velocity multiplied by triggerForce, e.g. triggerCustom="items=brick;destroy=0;temporary=1;posX=-10;posY=-20;rot=0" triggerContact="100" triggerForce="1000" triggerDuration="10" ignore="brick")

- [b]TeleportBehindOnHit[/b] (teleports on sharp every triggerDuration frames, moving towards hit body at triggerForce e.g. triggerForce="100" triggerDuration="10")

- [b]TemperatureInRadius[/b] (Modifies temperature of items in Radius by Force each frame.)

- [b]TriggerLinkedOnDestroy[/b] (triggers linked items when the item is destroyed)

notes.title: Bloody Mess Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/c283f542eece601ecff5b4d8943260fe535d35b6.png[/img][h1]Bloody Mess[/h1]

The most complex update the game has ever seen is finally here.

It adds [i]the[/i] most-requested feature ever to the game: Stabbing, and a ton of other relevant things.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/665370/MutilateaDoll_2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/5b467e66f37b7addd222c72fcb0b23d8e39683d3.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/8f1e3b650c496684861b2092b8bfd0c62eae326e.png[/img]

[h2]MaD Lab is now available on Steam![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/8ce81440db6db3a4430eea0830af7e89eb41e300.png[/img]

MaD Lab is the item modelling tool used to design all the new items in MaD2, and it's now available on Steam. Download it through the Tools category of your Steam Library:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/df3d3d1e21b5cae96284fb291ddc4f1260fb904d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/5330be1f7524c2ce63e8353bc51bcc6d1716b204.png[/img][/url]

In addition to all the bloody mess, this update also has improvements relevant to MaD Lab:
- [b]Model management has been revamped[/b], making it a lot easier to add your own models to the game.
- [b]Models are now saveable[/b] so you can make whatever you want in MaD Lab, and share it with others.

Tired of jointing bananas onto your high-tech space armour to decorate it? Try designing it in MaD Lab!
It'll not only look good, but also have better performance, and won't not immediately explode into a mess of joints in-game. Win-win-win.

Need help with MaD Lab? Ask for help on [url=http://www.discord.gg/MaD2]#MaD-Lab-Models on MaD2 Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/c283f542eece601ecff5b4d8943260fe535d35b6.png[/img]

[h1]Bloody Mess Patchnotes[/h1]

Even after rigorous beta testing (thanks, beta testers,) due to the complexity of the update, and the fact that sweeping changes like these affect essentially every single item in the game - that'd be 2663 at the time of writing - there will inevitably still be some issues left to fix.

As usual, [b]please report all bugs[/b] on [url=http://www.discord.gg/MaD2]MaD2 Discord[/url], or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/665370/discussions/3/]Bug Reports discussions[/url] so I can fix them.

The full, massive, patchnotes can be found below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/8f1e3b650c496684861b2092b8bfd0c62eae326e.png[/img]

[h2]TL;DR[/h2]

- Stabbing with sharp items.

- Bullet penetration.

- Dolls are now more durable by default.

- [Spawn > Settings > Alive Settings]

- Detail Tool has new toys, and a new look.

- MaD Lab is now available on Steam, and models are now saveable. Use it.

- Fixed all the bugs. Added more bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/c283f542eece601ecff5b4d8943260fe535d35b6.png[/img]

[h2]STABBING[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

  - [b]Sharp items will stab through dolls[/b], cutting them while doing so.
	
  - Stabbing will happen at a medium force or velocity.
    (whereas full on cutting happens at a high force or velocity.)
  
  - Plain [b]bullets will penetrate through dolls[/b], damaging them, and slowing down as they pass through.

  - Penetration depends on the bullet velocity and size.
  (tiny bullets slow down more)
  
[/expand] 

[h2]DOLLS[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

  - [b]Dolls are now generally much more durable[/b] by default, and default healths have been increased.
    (This was necessary to give items a wider damage range that was possible before,
	 since sharp items now deal consistent stabbing damage as they pass through a body.)

  - After years of training, [b]dolls can now headstand and bend their arms both ways[/b].
  
  - [b]Individual bodyparts can now be concussed[/b], and
    concussion also happens when receiving overwhelming damage over multiple hits
  
  - Dolls will get less adequate at standing as damaged
    (as opposed to suddenly flopping to the ground like before)
  
  - Individual bodyparts that are highly damaged, or concussed, will appear limp.
    (as opposed to disabling the entire doll's standing like before)
	
  - Health transfers slower between bodyparts by default,
    but bleeding and low health bodyparts drain health faster than before.
	
  - Regeneration property now heals for 0.1% of health per frame
    (instead of flat health per frame, so it's now stronger, and scales with high-health dolls)
[/expand] 


[h2]ALIVE SETTINGS[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]
[b]Added Alive Settings[/b]:

   A bunch of multiplier settings that affect dolls and other alive items have been added.
   They can be modified via [b][Spawn menu > Alive Settings][/b] when an alive item is selected, and via [b][Detail tool > Physics][/b].

   - % Health		 		- Health multiplier. (Only available in Spawn menu, as Detail tool has exact health.)		
   - % Concussion			- Damage required to concuss the item.															
   - % Standing				- Standing force. (Or dancing, at higher values.)																					
   - % Skin Thickness	 	- Force required for sharp items to cut and stab.												
   - % Body Density		 	- Items that stab dense items slow down more, and require more force to detach.	
   - % Bullet Penetration 	- How easily plain bullets pass through the item.
   - % Global Damage		- All damage received multiplier (stacks with other things below)
   - % Bullet Damage		- Plain bullet damage received multiplier.														 	
   - % Blunt Damage		 	- Blunt damage received multiplier.																
   - % Bleed Damage		 	- Bleed damage multiplier, affecting cuts and wounds.												
   - % Sharp Damage		 	- Cut damage received multiplier.		
[/expand] 


[h2]DAMAGE[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

[b]Tons of things have been rebalanced[/b] to match new doll healths.

Please report if there are any useless items or features that need buffing.

  - Cut and cut wound bleeding damage are generally lower
    (to compensate for cutting happening continuously as the item is stabbed)
  
  - Plain bullet damages and headshots have been modified to be more in line with new doll healths
  
  - Blunt item damage deals multiple instances of lower damage
    (instead of one huge cloud of blood per hard collision)
  
  - Fall/blunt damage against static objects is lower
  
  - Powers and various item features deal more damage to match new healths better

[b]Modify blood visuals[/b]:

  - The amount of blood and ites spread has been generally lowered,
    since stabbing applies *a lot* of damage and wounds
	
  - Blood visual effects have been modified
    (bleeding, cut wounds, stab wounds, bullet holes, blunt smacks, etc.)
[/expand] 


[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

  - Add [b][Freeze Item][/b] functionality (and unfreeze)
    (Disables/enables physics for the item, same as setting the item Static, or 0% Weight, but much less clunky.)
    (Hotkey: [N], one of few only remaining unmapped keys, modify via [Keymap > Item > Freeze Item])

  - Add [b][Detail > Functionality > Key Toggle][/b] on items
    (Choose a key* that toggles the trigger for the item when pressed.)
  
  - Add [b][Detail > Functionality > Key Hold][/b] on items
    (Choose a key* that triggers the item while pressed.)
    (* Will override the chosen key's normal functionality entirely.
    E.g. If you bind a bunch of items to WASD, those items will do the things instead of the camera moving.)

  - Add [b][Spawn > Skin > Opacity][/b] slider (0-100%) which modifies the transparency of the item
    (Note: Applies to the effects layer as well. This is not a bug but just how the graphics work: The effects layer is a child of the graphic, so transparency affects it.)
    (Can be set above 100%, in which case the model's transparent layers will also be boosted towards opaque)

  - Add [b][Properties > Resist Gravity][/b]
    (Always acts as if gravity was 20 and wind 0, even if environment settings are changed, and ignores gravity-modifying effects from items and the Crush power)

  - Add [b][Properties > Linked Also][/b]
    (when triggered, also triggers all linked items)
	
  - Add [b][Properties > Linked Only][/b]
    (when triggered, only triggers linked items.
	 Note that the base item is untriggered after each trigger, even if it would normally be toggled on.)

  - Modify [b][Properties > Resist Disintegrating][/b] to resist all forms of disintegration
    (Note that this also affects alive items disintegrating into blood when out of health)

  - Modify Rotate tool hotkey to be [R] in the default keymap because logic
    (swapping it with Scale tool, which is now [T])

  - Add [Alt+Enter] fullscreen toggle

[/expand] 


[h2]ITEM MODELS[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

[b]MaD Lab models are now saveable[/b]:

  - Meaning, [b]anyone can load saves that contain your item models[/b].

  - This can [b]increase your designs' performance[/b] immensely
    (because you can potentially replace dozens of items and a spiderweb of joints with a single item model.)

  - Model data is embedded in the save as-is at the time of saving.
	(E.g. Modifying the model and loading an old save will still contain the old model.)

  - Embedded model data can not reasonably be turned back into a MaD Lab item,
    so please back up your model files so you don't lose them.

  - Adding a lot of models, and/or very complex models, increases the size and load time of the save.

[b]Item model management redesign[/b]:

  The extremely clunky in-game management system has been replaced.
  Find it via [b][Library > Item Models][/b] (previously [Local Models]).

  - [b]All item model management is now done using the file system[/b]
    (Simply edit the model file using MaD Lab and the changes will be available in-game immediately without restart.)
	(Please back up your model files frequently, just in case.)

  - Added [Open Folder] button that opens the folder where models can be placed
    (It's located at: %APPDATA%/games.rava.mutilate/Local Store/models)

  - Added [Refresh] button that loads all the item models from the folder into the game

  - Added [MaD Lab] button that opens MaD Lab site
    (note that MaD Lab is now also available on Steam)

  - Add "Empty." under Item Models with help text if no models exist

  - Models.sol is now obsolete, but it still works for legacy purposes
    (Console commands "modelimport" and "modelmanage" can be used for manual model management)

[/expand] 


[h2]PHYSICS[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

Cutter:

  - [b]Cutter now works much better on small cuts[/b]. (aka Bag of Chips is no longer indestructible.)
    (and as such Min Cut Length setting has been removed as useless)
  
  - Cutter will now continue cutting even if the cut started inside a body
    (meaning that embedding [b]explosives inside items should work much better[/b])

  - Explosions now cut more, through multiple bodies, and more randomly

Shocks:

  - [b]Shocks now arc to nearby items[/b] (radius depending on their duration: short shocks will rarely arc, and longer ones will)

  - Shock spreading is now much more random (duration fades randomly instead of uniformly, and may increase when spreading to other items for a second wind)

Miscellaneous:

  - Fix bullets always colliding on first frame after spawning (even if the victim is supposed to ignore the collision)
  
  - Fix joints not recreating properly when respawning items

[/expand] 


[h2] VISUAL EFFECTS[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

  - [b]Stamping works with any spawned item[/b]
    (Note: only the detail item can be stamped this way, not all selected items like normally.
     Stamping this way includes all effects that are on the item,
     so custom items of often-used stamps can be created and then used to stamp after spawning.)

  - [b]Add muzzle flash to all plain bullet guns[/b].

  - Modify selection highlight vfx

  - Modify visual effects masking to look better on complex items

  - Fix flipping not flipping stains and stamps

  - Fix scaling scaling stamps wrong
[/expand] 


[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
[expand type=showmore]

Add [b]Turbo Propertator[/b]
(Overrides linked items' properties with this item's properties)

Add [b]Turbo Linkerator[/b]
(Overrides jointed items' links with this item's links)

The Bloody Mess Beta Test is a sneak peek at some of the upcoming new features where you can help destroy all the bugs before the update is released.

This is one of the largest updates made to the game ever, so there [b]will[/b] be tons of issues, which is why it's releasing on the opt-in Experimental Branch first.

To play the beta, navigate to [Steam > Library > MaD2 > Properties > Betas] and select the Experimental branch. After that, redownload the game and you should gain access to the beta update.

The full, massive, patchnotes can be found below, and all testing and bug reporting should be related to them in some way during the test.

------------------------

Add physics stabbing:

  - Any item that has a sharp layer will attempt to stab through dolls,
    temporarily disabling collisions and damaging the doll.
	
  - Stabbing happens at medium force or velocity.
  (Cutting happens at high force or velocity.)
  
  - Modify sticky items not to lose their velocity when stuck
  
  Known issue: Weapons may get ejected from stab wounds.
    Stabbing is physics-based, working via weak joints. It's a delicate balance of being able to remove the weapons, and the weapons falling out on their own. I'll keep tweaking it.
  
  Known issue: Stabbing is not consistent.
    It will likely be different on each load of a save due to physics jitter. This is not something that can be fixed, really, but may be improved.

Add physics bullet penetration:

  - Penetration mainly depends on the bullet velocity,
    but bullets will slow down as they pass through bodies.
  
  Known issue: Bullets may boomerang back towards the body they stabbed.
  
  Known issue: Even "weak" bullet-spewing weapons are currently able to penetrate.
  The system will be fleshed out eventually so there's more differentiation between different weapons.

Modify dolls:

  - Doll healths are now 500% of what they were before by default.
    (This was necessary to give items a wider damage range that was possible before,
	 since sharp items now deal consistent stabbing damage as they pass through a body.)

    Known issue: This will break a lot of items that deal flat damage. Report them so they can be buffed.
	
  - Doll hands now bend both ways.
  
  - Concussions now require a harder hit.
  
  - Regeneration property now heals for 0.1% of health per frame
    (instead of flat health per frame, so it's now stronger, and scales with high-health dolls)

  - Modify cut sounds to be more varied in volume

[url=https://rava.games/madlab/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34463552/72b26ed93570cbd216231294e31c2e8557199756.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://rava.games/madlab/]MaD Lab[/url] is the item editor that has been used to design almost all models in the game. It's publicly available, and can be used to make your own item models.

It's a bit complicated, but the Cryolab update's models were entirely made using the new functionality, so it shouldn't be insurmountable, especially when following the documentation.

[url=https://rava.games/madlab/]Design your own model now in MaD Lab![/url]

notes.title: Incremental Loading Test
notes.content:
Incremental loading test is now live on the Experimental branch.
It's very much a work in progress, and full release will be later on, once the feature has been tested a bit more because there are so many things that will probably break.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2V6TpQk.gif[/img]

[b]What is incremental loading?[/b]
The game will spawn items across multiple frames to lessen the loading performance load. Joints and links will be loaded in a single frame afterwards.

[b]Why?[/b]
More complex levels will noticeably chug, or even freeze the game, while attempting to bruteforce everything in a single frame traditionally. Plus it looks really cool while it loads.

[b]How can I test?[/b]
0) Opt-in via `[Steam Library > Right Click MaD2 > Properties > Betas tab > Experimental]` and verify your files.

1) Load all the things: Old saves, new saves, custom items, slightly moist saves, etc.

2) Report any issues, and make sure you include the save string (paste to e.g. https://pastie.io/)

----

[b]Notes[/b]:
- Reseting while loading will stop loading and reset.

- Hotkeys are disabled while loading because there's a lot of ways to accidentally mess it up.

- Unpausing while loading is currently possible, and custom items won't automatically pause before loading. Loading while simulating will very likely mess everything up.

- Level pictured is "Traditional Japanese House" by iFancyMan

notes.title: Workshop Beta
notes.content:
Very rudimentary Workshop support is now in very experimental beta stage.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34463552/ef6dee84f796d7bac4391eb5b410fb101ec2236c.png[/img]

[h1]How?[/h1]
1) Install the latest version of game.

2) Paperwork
You [b]must [/b] agree to the Workshop User Agreement before sharing will work
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/workshoplegalagreement/

3) Open Workshop
- Browser: https://steamcommunity.com/app/665370/workshop/
- Steam: steam://url/SteamWorkshopPage/665370
- In-game: [Content Menu -> Load Content -> Steam Workshop] (which just opens the Steam link.)

4) Subscribe to Content

Press the green [+] button on thumbnails, or the [Subscribe] button after clicking on an item.

Note that managing subscriptions, voting, and analytics will be done entirely on the Workshop, and won't be added in-game so there's no need to reinvent the wheel and all.

5) Download Content In MaD2
Press [Library -> Workshop -> Download Subscribed]

The game will then query all your subscribed content via the SDK, and hopefully download it all.

Note that your content is not cached locally, so this has to be done every time you run the game, but luckily the content is just text at the end of the day so it should be kilobytes in size.

6) Play
For Levels, simply click to load them.
For Custom Items, drag them out of the Library, or click and spawn them via the Spawn menu.

7) Submit Your MaD2 Content
[b]Custom Items[/b]
Create a Custom Item via the Detail Tool (See Tutorial if you don't know how.)
Submit it via [Library -> Custom Items -> Manage -> Share]

[b]Levels[/b]
Save at any time via [Content Menu -> Save] (or press [C] to quicksave]
Share it via [Content Menu -> Current Save -> Share on Workshop]

Sharing requires previewing to ensure you're not sharing broken stuff.

Note that there has to be at least three unique items in a save for it to be valid for sharing.

[h1]Gotchas[/h1]
As mentioned, this is rudimentary at best. It should work, as demonstrated by the few example items already available in the workshop, but beautiful it is not.

I'm using a years old AIR extension which in turn uses deprecated Steamworks SDK functions. Not the best solution, but miraculously it does work, as long as Valve doesn't decide to entirely remove the deprecated stuff.

* Applying tags don't seem work with the deprecated SDK, so content titles are used to categorize things instead. Please don't remove or replace the tags manually to avoid weird things happening.

* Updating submitted content is not possible yet, but might be, eventually.

* There's barely any useful feedback on your actions in-game currently, it either works or doesn't. Restarting the game should something fail is probably a good bet.

* Sharing and loading content obviously requires connectivity. The game will throw a (harmless) error if you try to do things in Offline mode.

[h1]Feedback?[/h1]
Post any feedback you may have, and accompanying error logs here please:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/665370/discussions/0/1675812484354058197/



Enjoy.
